name: natDegree_wronskian_lt_add
statement: R[X]} (hw : wronskian a b ≠ 0) : (wronskian a b).natDegree < a.natDegree + b.natDegree

have_tree.name: ha
have_tree.body: by intro h; subst h; rw [wronskian_zero_left] at hw; exact hw rfl

have_tree.name: hb
have_tree.body: by intro h; subst h; rw [wronskian_zero_right] at hw; exact hw rfl
